changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionAssetDataProfile') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [Success] bit NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [AssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ProfileSetDate] DATE NOT NULL, [TotalCount] BIGINT NULL, [DistinctValues] BIGINT NULL, [NullCount] BIGINT NULL, [BlankCount] BIGINT NULL, [MeanValue] DECIMAL(22,4) NULL, [MinimumValue] NVARCHAR(500) NULL, [MaximumValue] NVARCHAR(500) NULL, [MinimumLength] INT NULL, [MaximumLength] INT NULL, [StandardDeviation] DECIMAL(28,4) NULL, [NewType] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [Multiline] BIT NULL, [Validation] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [Confidence] DECIMAL(28,4) NULL, [TypeQualifier] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [CurrentType] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [JavaType] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [LogicalType] BIT NULL, [LeadingWhiteSpace] BIT NULL, [LeadingZeroCount] INT NULL, [TrailingWhiteSpace] BIT NULL, [MatchCount] BIGINT NULL, [OutlierCardinality] INT NULL, [PossibleKey] BIT NULL, [PrimaryKey] DECIMAL(28,4) NULL, [DataSignature] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [StructureSignature] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [Cardinality] INT NULL, [ShapeCardinality] INT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ExecutionAssetDataProfile] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] ASC, [ItemNumber] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ON [PRIMARY] ) ON [PRIMARY] END
